enriched.title: Tempos Verbais e Pronúncia em Inglês
enriched.summary: A aula aborda a conjugação de verbos em diversos tempos verbais, com foco em exemplos práticos. Além disso, inclui a pronúncia de palavras-chave e vocabulário útil para conversação.

vocabulary.definition: To move across something, typically a barrier or boundary.
examples: A few ships crossed the Strait of Hormuz last month.
She loves to dance at parties.

vocabulary.definition: Past tense of 'dance'; moved rhythmically to music.
examples: He danced beautifully at the wedding.

grammar.explanation: Os tempos verbais descrevem diferentes momentos de ação ou estado em uma frase.
rules: Past Simple: verbo no passado regular (-ed) ou forma irregular
Future with Going To: sujeito + 'to be' + going to + verbo base
examples: The biggest tech companies are betting big on computers that control themselves.
Last year, the biggest tech companies bet big on computers that control themselves.
The biggest tech companies will bet big on computers that control themselves.
commonMistakes: Confundir Present Continuous com Present Simple.
Usar 'will' no lugar de 'going to' em frases planejadas.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugue o verbo 'invest' no Past Continuous.
practiceQuestions.explanation: No Past Continuous, usamos 'to be' no passado (was/were) + verbo com -ing.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugue o verbo 'push' no Present Perfect.
practiceQuestions.explanation: No Present Perfect, usamos 'have/has' + o particípio passado do verbo.

culturalNotes: O uso de tempos verbais é essencial para indicar o contexto temporal em conversas formais e informais.
A pronúncia correta de palavras como 'crossed' e 'danced' ajuda na clareza ao falar sobre ações passadas.
studyTips: Pratique os tempos verbais com frases do dia a dia, como rotinas e eventos recentes.
Ouça gravações de palavras com pronúncia desafiadora para aprimorar sua fala e compreensão.
originalExamples: The biggest tech companies are betting big on computers that control themselves.
Last year, the biggest tech companies bet big on computers that control themselves.
The biggest tech companies will bet big on computers that control themselves.
Economists are pushing for prediction markets.
Economists always push for prediction markets.
A few ships are crossing the Strait of Hormuz again.
A few ships crossed the Strait of Hormuz last month.
The Gulf countries are investing in the video game industry massively.

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
